item.title: Taiwan shuts schools and grounds flights as Typhoon Champi brushes by
item.description: TAIPEI, Taiwan (AP) — Taiwan shut down schools and offices and grounded hundreds of flights as Typhoon Champi brushed by the island Friday, packing strong winds and torrential rains. Champi peaked at 298 kph (185 mph) maximum sustained winds earlier this week but has weakened to 155 kph (96 mph) winds as it approached Taiwan […] Publicado también por: ABC News Australia, BBC News - World. item.title: From 'gentle' and 'graceful' to the 'cane toad of the sky': How Australia turned on the common myna
item.description: The common myna is sometimes referred to as "Australia's most hated bird." Originally from South and Central Asia, the introduced species from the starling family is abundant, raucous and bold. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Why do women in public life become targets?
item.description: A brutal targeted attack on an Australian female MP, who lost both her legs as a result, has reignited concerns over the rising levels of violence against women in public life. Also Cornell University is facing a no-confidence vote over its handling of an alleged gang rape in 2024. Annette Young speaks to Annie E. Clark, a survivor of campus sexual assault and Dr Sara Wilf of George Mason University about why institutions continue to struggle with sexual assault cases. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: Jepchirchir tested positive for banned blood booster EPO in a sample taken before her Sydney Marathon win in August. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: ‘I always think my head will fall off when Traitors turn on each other’: the inside story of the world’s biggest TV show
item.description: Celia’s guffs, Richard’s gaffes, Claudia’s glorious knitwear – The Traitors has become the most successful show on the planet. The creators and the queen of the castle herself talk exploding pirate ships, becoming evil and Barry the owl It all began on a Dutch trading ship in 1628. No, really. When the Batavia set sail from Amsterdam, it crashed and the shipwrecked survivors were left stranded on a tiny island off the coast of Western Australia. As mutineers eyed the Batavia’s stash of silver, shipmates, friends and families turned on each other. About 100 people were brutally murdered… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: Dimite el jefe de las Fuerzas Armadas de Nueva Zelanda por una «relación inapropiada» en el pasado
item.description: El jefe de las Fuerzas Armadas de Nueva Zelanda, Tony Davies, ha presentado este viernes su dimisión a causa de «una relación inapropiada» durante su periodo en un puesto de mando en una unidad neozelandesa, sin que por ahora hayan trascendido más detalles sobre las circunstancias de esta relación o cuándo tuvo lugar.« Mi dimisión se debe a motivos personales y es consecuencia de errores de juicio que cometí en el pasado, de los cuales asumo la responsabilidad. Dichos errores de juicio fueron contrarios a los valores de la Fuerza de Defensa», ha dicho Davies en una carta para anunciar su… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
